title: Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program
summary: Introduce your children to the richness of Saudi Arabia's traditional arts at the Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program 2026, organized by the Royal Institute of Traditional Arts (Wrth). Taking place at Riyadh Park from 16 to 18 July 2026, the program offers children aged 8–12 an enriching summer experience through a sensory, hands-on journey exploring the traditional arts of the Kingdom's diverse regions. Through a variety of interactive activity stations, children will discover heritage-inspired crafts including pottery, Al Sadu weaving, traditional incense burner (mabkharah) making, Najdi door decoration, and other traditional art forms. Designed to nurture creativity, develop practical skills, and deepen appreciation for Saudi culture, the program provides an engaging environment where young learners can explore, create, and connect with the Kingdom's rich artistic heritage.
